title: Establishment and maintenance of human naive pluripotent stem cells by primed to naive conversion and reprogramming of fibroblasts
protocol: For MEF medium, mix DMEM with 10% FBS, 1% nonessential amino acids, 1mM GlutaMAX, 1% Pen-strep, 0.1mM 2-mercaptoethanol, and 1mM sodium pyruvate.
For Medium 106, add 10ml of LSGS to 500ml medium 106 basal; supplement with 1% Pen-strep.
For Essential 8 medium, add 10ml of Essential 8 supplement to 500ml medium basal; supplement with 1% Pen-strep.

Prepare NHSM medium by mixing DMEM/F12 with AlbuMAX I, Pen-strep, GlutaMAX, nonessential amino acids, KnockOut Serum Replacement, N2 supplement, recombinant human insulin, L-ascorbic acid, LIF, FGF2, TGF-β1, LR3-IGF1, PD0325901, CHIR99021, SP600125, BIRB796, LDN193189, Y-27632, and Gö6983.
For RSeT medium, prepare as specified for NHSM medium.
Add 100ml of RSeT 5X supplement into 398.5ml of RSeT Basal Medium.
Add 1ml of RSeT 500X supplement into the mixture prepared in the previous step.
Add 0.5ml of RSeT 1000X supplement into the mixture.
Supplement the mixture with 1% Pen-strep.
Prepare a 50:50 mixture of DMEM/F-12 and Neurobasal medium for _5iLAF medium_.
Supplement the mixture with 1% N2 supplement.
Add 2% B27 supplement to the mixture.
Include 1% nonessential amino acids in the mixture.
Add 1mM GlutaMAX to the mixture.
Include 0.1mM 2-mercaptoethanol in the mixture.
Add 50μg/ml BSA to the mixture.
Supplement with 1μM PD0325901.
Include 1μM IM-12 in the mixture.
Add 0.5μM SB590885 to the mixture.
Supplement with 1μM WH-4-023.
Include 10μM Y-27632 in the mixture.
Add 20ng/ml Activin A to the mixture.
Supplement with 8ng/ml FGF2.
Include 20ng/ml human LIF made in house.
Add 0.5% KSR to the mixture.
Filter all culture media before use with a 0.22μm filter.
Prepare a 50:50 mixture of DMEM/F-12 and Neurobasal medium for _t2iLGöY medium_.
Supplement the mixture with 2mM L-glutamine.
Include 0.1mM 2-mercaptoethanol in the mixture.
Add 0.5% N2 supplement to the mixture.
Include 1% B27 supplement in the mixture.
Add 1% Pen-strep to the mixture.
Supplement with 10ng/ml human LIF made in house.
Include 250μM L-ascorbic acid in the mixture.
Add 10µg/ml recombinant human insulin to the mixture.
Supplement with 1μM PD0325901.
Include 1μM CHIR99021 in the mixture.
Add 2.5μM Gö6983 to the mixture.
Include 10μM Y-27632 in the mixture.
Thaw cryopreserved primary human adult dermal fibroblasts quickly at 37°C.
Pellet the cells at 200xg for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 ml of 106 medium supplemented with LSGS and plate into a T75 flask.
Culture the cells in a 37°C, 5% O₂ and 5% CO₂ incubator.
Change media every other day during expansion.
Split cultures at a ratio of 1:3-1:5 when they reach confluence.
Freeze cells for cryopreservation in 90% FBS with 10% DMSO.
Coat culture vessels with vitronectin according to manufacturer’s instructions for 1 hour at room temperature.
Maintain conventional primed human iPSCs and H9 ESCs in a feeder-free E8 media system.
Passage cells every 4-5 days.
Wash cells twice with PBS to remove traces of calcium and magnesium.
Overlay cultures with a 0.5 mM EDTA/PBS solution for approximately 5 minutes.
Aspirate the EDTA solution from the culture flask.
Use fresh E8 medium to break colonies into small clumps by gently pipetting.
Transfer 1/10th of the solution (1:10 split) into a fresh culture vessel.
Add sufficient E8 medium required for the particular culture vessel format.
Add 10 μM Y-27632 to the E8 media to boost viability.
Culture cells in a 37°C, 5% O₂ and 5% CO₂ incubator.
Change media on a daily basis.
Seed irradiated mouse embryonic fibroblasts \(iMEFs) at 2x10^4 cells/cm^2 into 6-well plates one day before the experiment.
Seed ~0.5x10^5-1x10^5 human primed ESCs or iPSCs per well of a 6-well plate onto the iMEF layer in E8 medium with 10μM Y-27632.
Switch to human naive NHSM medium after 24 or 48 hours.
Wash confluent cultures with PBS when ready for passaging.
Incubate cells with Accutase for ~3-5 minutes to dissociate them gently.
Spin down the cells at 200xg for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in naive NHSM medium and seed onto a fresh iMEF layer using a split ratio of 1:5-1:20.
Culture the cells in a 37°C, 5% O₂ and 5% CO₂ incubator.
Change media daily.
Passage cells every 4-5 days.
Prepare 6-well plates with iMEFs one day in advance.
Dissociate primed cells into small clumps using 0.5 mM EDTA/PBS solution.
Seed 0.5x10^5 to 1x10^5 dissociated primed cells per 6-well onto the prepared iMEF feeder layer in E8 medium with 10 μM Y-27632.
Switch to naive RSeT medium after 24 hours and change media daily.
When culture is confluent, passage cells using TrypLE express.
Incubate for ~3-5 minutes and then dilute and dissociate cells by repeated gentle pipetting with DMEM/F-12 media.
Pellet cells at 300xg for 5 minutes.
Resuspend pelleted cells in naive RSeT medium.
Seed resuspended cells onto a fresh layer of iMEFs at a 1:4 to 1:10 split ratio.
Culture and maintain cells in a 37°C, 5% O2, and 5% CO2 incubator.
Change media daily for the cell line.
Passage cells every 4-5 days.
Seed 0.5~1x10^5 primed cells per well onto the feeder layer of iMEFs in E8 medium with 10 μM Y-27632.
Incubate for 48 hours, then switch to human naive 5iLAF medium.
Passage cells onto a fresh layer of iMEFs using Accutase when cultures are confluent at a 1:10-1:20 ratio every 6-7 days.
Coat 6-well plates with vitronectin (VTN-N) for 1 hour at room temperature as per manufacturer's instructions.
Gently dissociate primed cells and seed onto VTN-N coated 6-well plates in E8 medium with 10 μM Y-27632.
Sendai viral transduction can be performed in E8 medium with MOI of 5, 5, and 6 for OSKM mediated conversion or KLF4 at a MOI=6 for KLF4 only conversion.
Replace the medium with fresh E8 medium 24 hours after Sendai viral transduction.
Seed iMEF feeders at 2x10^4 cells/cm^2 on top of the converting primed cells simultaneously.
Switch to naive t2iLGöY medium after another 24 hours post seeding of iMEFs.
Passage cells using Accutase onto a feeder layer of iMEFs when cultures are confluent at a split ratio of 1:10-1:20.
Monitor for the appearance of naive dome-shaped colonies after 2-4 passages.
Seed ~2-4x10^4 cells per well on VTN-N coated 12-well plates in E8 medium with 10μM Y-27632.
Transfect cells with NM-RNA reprogramming transfection complex containing Opti-MEM, RNAiMAX, EKB mRNA, and human KLF4 mRNA after 1-2 days.
Replace the medium with fresh E8 medium 15 hours later.
Repeat the transfection process daily for another 8 days in E8 medium.
Passage the cells onto a feeder layer of iMEFs in E8 medium on day 10.
Perform another round of transfection on day 10 after passage.
Switch the medium to naive t2iLGöY medium the next day.
Repeat the transfection process for another 5 days in naive t2iLGöY medium.
Passage the cells using Accutase onto a fresh layer of irradiated MEFs.
Trypsinize cells on day 7.
Count the trypsinized cells.
Seed cells onto a layer of iMEF feeders or VTN-N coated T25 flasks at ~1-2x10^5 cells per flask in MEF medium.
Transition cells to different culture media including primed and naive conditions (NHMS, RSeT, 5iLAF, t2iLGöY) the next day.
Change the media daily for all conditions thereafter.
Passage and expand cells 21 days after transduction using methods and media as described.
Subclone colonies by picking them with a dissection microscope.
Seed 2x10^4 primary HDFa per well of a 12-well plate in MEF medium.
Transfect cells with NM-RNA reprogramming complex containing OSKMNL NM-RNA, EKB NM-RNA, and NM-microRNAs using Opti-MEM and RNAiMAX according to manufacturer’s instructions after 24 hours.
Renew the media with fresh MEF medium 15 hours later.
Repeat the transfection process for another 3 days.
Trypsinize cells on day 5.
Seed approximately 1-2x10^5 cells per T25 flask onto VTN-N coated T25 flasks or onto iMEF feeders in MEF medium.
Transition cells to E8 medium or naive t2iLGöY medium the next day.
Passage E8 primed iPSCs with 0.5mM EDTA/PBS onto VTN-N coated T25 flasks every 4-5 days.
Passage naive t2iLGöY iPSCs with Accutase onto fresh iMEF feeders every 6-7 days.
Trypsinize established naive t2iLGöY cells for conversion to the primed state.
Seed trypsinized cells onto VTN-N coated 6-well plates in a range of densities using t2iLGöY media for 24 hours.
Transition cells to E8 medium the next day.
Culture and passage converted cells as described above for E8 primed cells.
